design.allocation: certainty units first; remaining slots allocated over noncertainty records by Hamilton largest remainder proportional to stratum random-pool size
certainty_rules: record is one of the eight published boundary cases
design.confidence_reporting: Report design-weighted discrepancy estimates and intervals; simple-random-sample rule-of-three bounds are not valid for this unequal-probability design.
design.estimator: Horvitz-Thompson over the complete 610-record finite frame using exact stored inclusion probabilities; certainty units have probability one
design.random_selection: within each noncertainty stratum rank SHA-256(domain_separator NUL seed_sha256 NUL stratum_id NUL record_id), then select the lowest allocated ranks
